author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: October's flat US CPI and two-year-low core inflation turned the October bond rout into a parallel 39 bps 20-observation rally in the 2Y and 10Y, a weaker dollar and a breadth-led, rate-sensitive equity rebound (Russell 2000, regional banks, REITs, utilities). The edition leans into that relief where a domestic catalyst compounds it (Poland's GDP turn and government transition, US small caps and banks, semiconductors), while flagging that the curve is still inverted, Japan contracted, euro-area growth is stagnant and China's property drag persists.
sources_policy: Facts come only from 2023-11-15 own-date headlines cited inline in the same paragraph, or from the 2023-11-15 market card (completed sessions before 2023-11-15T00:00Z). Spot-FX levels/returns are not used; currency direction is taken from cited headlines. Company news/previews within seven days, results within fourteen, macro releases and policy baselines within thirty-five. Headlines whose described event was released on 2023-11-15 itself were not used.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0238 (Reuters, 'China's factory output, consumption beat forecasts...'): stamped 2023-11-14 08:00 but China's October activity data are released at 10:00 Beijing on 2023-11-15 (02:00 UTC), after the cutoff; treated as premature/misdated and not used.

n0234 (Reuters, 'China c.bank boosts liquidity injection through policy loan, rate unchanged'): describes the PBOC's mid-month MLF operation conducted on the morning of 2023-11-15 Beijing time, after the cutoff; not used.

n1346 (European Central Bank, 'Financial Stability Review, November 2023'): date-only 2023-11-14 stamp; the November review appears to be a later-month publication, so its timing is doubtful; not used.
n1593 (Reuters, 'Japanese yen jumps against dollar'): date-only stamp makes the session ambiguous; used only for currency direction, with no session or level attached.

n0881 vs n0980/n0981 (Siemens Energy guarantees): n0881 (sources) says a $16 bln deal was to be unveiled on Wednesday, while n0980 already reports $8 bln of German government guarantees on 2023-11-14; each figure is attributed to its own headline and the 'Wednesday' unveiling is not presented as a dated pending event.

n0865 (Novo Nordisk shares rise on Wegovy heart data) refers to the 2023-11-13 session, while the card shows NOVO-B.CO -1.54% for the 2023-11-14 session; the two are not merged into one claim about the same session.
n1601/n1602 (Japan Q3 GDP contraction): released 08:50 JST on 2023-11-15 = 23:50 UTC on 2023-11-14, i.e., before the cutoff; used as eligible.

Later-dated or rolling pages in the feed, not used: n0263 ('March 2025 Edition'), n0609 ('Black Friday Stocks List 2025'), n2100 ('ADP Payroll Review 2026'), n1594 (2025 journal article), n0052/n0055/n1401 and n1102/n1119 (rolling currency/coin forecast pages to 2026-2040).
n1729 (NBP fixing table with a numeric EUR/PLN rate) not used because numeric spot-FX is prohibited; zloty direction taken from n1761 and n1611 only.
